kind: synthetic construction boundary; not a live allocation
hypothesis: DoomCoverSignalPairMonitor uses typed health/ammo evidence to invalidate a cover; an advanced-epoch screen-frame hash change alone is not evaluated as a reason to stop.
test: One paired observation with stable health/ammo and changed frame hash versus one with health below the configured hard floor.
decision: Capability probe only. A screen-only change may preserve cover; a hard typed health crossing must request a new decision. No tactical safety or gameplay claim.
confounds_and_limits: Synthetic signals and frame hashes; no DOOM process, model, GUI, OS input, or physical release.
Pixel/hash change has no semantic threat interpretation.
No causal survival, policy appropriateness, useful feedback, or recovery effect measured.
retry_policy: No live allocation used. This bounded construction run is executed once and retained; later changes require a new versioned probe.
counterhypothesis: A raw frame hash change is not necessarily a threat or policy-relevant semantic change; generic hash-triggered cancellation could interrupt useful cover unnecessarily.
uncertainty: Synthetic single-frame hash/HUD pair only; no semantic visual classifier, live threat, policy consequence, release timing, useful feedback, or task effect was measured.
prior_smoke: An earlier unrecorded in-memory smoke check exercised the same two branches before this package freeze; it is not counted as the recorded candidate. This packaged candidate was run once after the freeze timestamp.
